plugins.name: danger-check
plugins.description: Asks you before a command that can destroy work, such as rm -rf, git reset --hard or git push --force.

plugins.name: done-sound
plugins.description: Plays a sound when a long turn ends and when Claude waits for your answer.

plugins.name: no-new-branch
plugins.description: Asks you before any command that would create a new git branch or worktree.

plugins.name: no-process-kill
plugins.description: Asks you before any command that would stop a running process.

plugins.name: pnpm-only
plugins.description: Blocks npm and npx commands and tells Claude the pnpm command to use instead.

plugins.name: prompt-snippets
plugins.description: Replaces short names such as ;plan in your prompt with longer texts that you saved.

plugins.name: quote-selection
plugins.description: The /quote command puts the text you selected with the mouse into your prompt as a quote.

plugins.name: usage-line
plugins.description: Shows live session cost, context use, and the 5-hour and weekly limits in one line above the prompt.
